name: Bun sua
summary: Bún sứa is jellyfish in a light broth simmered from bones and seafood. Vietnam Airlines calls the jellyfish crisp and the broth lightly sweet, and prints 40,000–70,000 VND.
origin: Vung Tau. Vietnam Airlines names Cô Giang and Tô Hiến Thành.
howToEat: Eat it as a bowl, with greens, herbs, chili, and lime.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Cô Giang and Tô Hiến Thành. A shop name is not published here. The hour is Check on arrival.
